summary: Trivial getter (thiscall): returns the 32-bit value of this[62], i.e. the dword at byte offset 0xF8 of the receiver. No side effects and no parameters beyond this.

local_names.this: receiver object whose field at +0xF8 is read

operations.description: return this[62], reading the dword at byte offset 0xF8 (index 62) of this; read-only access with no other operations
